title: Cash Pickup Refunds: Status, Amount by Basis, Timing and Destination
content:
**Payments operations desk note: Cash Pickup refunds.**

## Which transfers

Principal is refunded only on a Cash Pickup transfer whose status is cancelled, expired or paid out. On a paid-out transfer it is refunded only as an error-resolution remedy.

## Amount by refund basis

| Refund basis | Principal refunded |
|---|---|
| cancellation | the principal collected (the funds-received amount) |
| expiry | the principal collected |
| request for information expired unanswered | the principal collected |
| compliance rejection | the principal collected |
| error resolution | what the error-resolution rules set |
| error shortfall | what the error-resolution rules set |

On the two compliance bases, a request for information expired unanswered and a compliance rejection, each booking fee collected is also refunded at the tier's share for Paloma-cancelled held transfers, recorded as a compliance cancellation.

Each refund basis is paid once against its source entry.

## Timing and destination

A refund is issued within the tier's refund business days, counted as Paloma business days from the day it became owed. It goes to the original funding method. A wire is refunded by ACH credit to the account it came from.

For a customer whose state of residence is CA, a refund requested in writing is issued within 10 calendar days of the request, when that is sooner. This applies when the money has not been paid out.

## Closing the transfer

Once the principal refund is booked, the transfer moves to refunded. The one exception is a shortfall refund (the error-shortfall basis), which leaves a paid-out transfer paid out.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A Cash Pickup transfer whose status is ready for pickup is not refundable as it stands.
- A CA resident makes a written request on 3 June, on a transfer whose money has not been paid out. The 10-calendar-day limit falls on 13 June. If the refund-business-day limit falls earlier, that earlier date governs. Otherwise 13 June governs, being the sooner.
- A refund recorded on the cancellation basis against the funds-received entry is not paid a second time on that basis.
